title: Beginners Guide To Amazon FBA In 2026
summary: An Amazon seller explains FBA vs FBM, arbitrage vs wholesale vs private label, four product checks (rank, seller count, no Amazon on the listing, ROI threshold) and the end-to-end shipping workflow.

assertions.quote: as Amazon does the fulfillment for you, they charge you fulfillment fees, which does take up your profit.

verdicts.note: Combined referral, fulfillment and storage fees commonly take 30 to 50 percent of the sale price, per Amazon's own fee schedules.

assertions.quote: it's only recommended for people who just go for shopping and they want to make a quick buck here and there

verdicts.note: Clearance deals are one-off and retailers cap quantities, so arbitrage income is irregular and labour-intensive; this is widely acknowledged even by its promoters.

assertions.quote: people are already buying brandame products. So, you won't have to even create any demand. You don't even have to run any ads

verdicts.note: Demand is real, but every other wholesaler can join the same listing, so margins get competed down to near nothing on popular items.

assertions.quote: You need at least 5 to£10,000 or dollars because remember, you're buying your product from China.

verdicts.note: Minimum order quantities, barcodes, trademarks, photography and launch advertising routinely cost several thousand before the first sale.

assertions.quote: if Amazon's on the listing, my friend, you are never going to win on Amazon because Amazon will sell the product cheaper than you.

verdicts.note: Amazon retail has structural cost advantages and the buy-box algorithm favours price, so competing on its own listings is a well-known losing proposition.

assertions.quote: the seller owns that listing and they will complain to Amazon and then Amazon will literally block your account if you do that multiple times.

verdicts.note: Brand registry lets owners report unauthorised sellers and repeated complaints do lead to suspensions, though a single instance usually does not.
Intellectual-property violations were one of the two main reasons Amazon suspended most Empire-managed stores; the complaint does not detail the brand-complaint mechanism.

assertions.quote: there is a hidden fee on your Amazon fees and your fulfillment cost, which is 20% VAT that is charged on this.

verdicts.note: In the UK and EU, Amazon adds VAT to seller fees for non-VAT-registered sellers who cannot reclaim it, which reduces the net margin shown.

assertions.quote: your first wholesale order should always be a test order. Meaning, it should be anywhere from 10 to 50 units of that product.

verdicts.note: Small test orders limit downside from gating, undercutting or slow sales; it is standard inventory risk management.

assertions.quote: if you still want my personal help to build a sixfigure Amazon FBA business under 12 months

verdicts.note: Vendor claim with named success stories but no data on how many clients paid versus reached that result; six-figure revenue is also not profit.

Automators' $5,000 one-on-one Amazon coaching advertised students making $10,000+ a month, but the FTC alleges virtually none of its coaching clients made the advertised amounts and most did not recoup their investment.
